audience: creators and merchants who sell digital products on Kiwify

useCases.title: Review sales for a period
useCases.text: Get the sales statistics, then list the sales in a window of up to 90 days. Open one sale for its buyer and payment details.

useCases.title: Look up a product and its details
useCases.text: List the products in the store, then open one product by its id.

useCases.title: Track balances and payouts
useCases.text: List the balances of the account, then list the payouts. Open one payout to read its details.

useCases.title: Follow installment plans
useCases.text: List the installment plans created in a window of up to 90 days. Open one plan to see its installments.

useCases.title: Review affiliates and webhooks
useCases.text: List the affiliates of the store, then open one affiliate. List the webhook endpoints of the store.
